package objectenum_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	client "example.com/objectenum/gen/http/numbers/client"
	server "example.com/objectenum/gen/http/numbers/server"
	numbers "example.com/objectenum/gen/numbers"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
)

const wireName = "__WIRE_NAME__"

func TestPreparedEnumRequests(t *testing.T) {
	calls := 0
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	endpoints := &numbers.Endpoints{Exchange: func(_ context.Context, raw any) (any, error) {
		calls++
		payload := raw.(*numbers.EnumAlias)
		if payload.N == nil || *payload.N != 2 {
			t.Errorf("unexpected service payload: %#v", payload)
		}
		return payload, nil
	}}
	server.Mount(mux, server.New(endpoints, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil))
	for _, n := range []int{1, 2, 3} {
		before := calls
		request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/numbers", strings.NewReader(fmt.Sprintf(`{"%s":%d}`, wireName, n)))
		request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(response, request)
		if n == 2 {
			if response.Code != 200 || calls != before+1 || !strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), fmt.Sprintf(`"%s":2`, wireName)) {
				t.Errorf("n=%d status=%d calls=%d body=%s", n, response.Code, calls, response.Body.String())
			}
		} else {
			code := "invalid_enum_value"
			if n == 1 {
				code = "invalid_range"
			}
			var problem struct {
				Code   string `json:"code"`
				Detail string `json:"detail"`
			}
			if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &problem); err != nil {
				t.Errorf("decode problem response: %v", err)
			}
			detailOK := problem.Detail == "validation error"
			if n == 3 {
				detailOK = strings.HasPrefix(problem.Detail, `invalid value for "body":`) &&
					strings.Contains(problem.Detail, fmt.Sprintf(`expected one of map[string]interface {}{%q:1}, map[string]interface {}{%q:2}`, wireName, wireName))
			}
			if response.Code != 400 || calls != before || problem.Code != code || !detailOK {
				t.Errorf("n=%d status=%d calls=%d body=%s", n, response.Code, calls, response.Body.String())
			}
		}
	}
}

func TestPreparedEnumClientResponses(t *testing.T) {
	for _, n := range []int{1, 2, 3} {
		host := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(w, `{"%s":%d}`, wireName, n); err != nil {
				t.Errorf("write response: %v", err)
			}
		}))
		cli := client.NewClient("http", strings.TrimPrefix(host.URL, "http://"), http.DefaultClient, loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
		value := 2
		raw, err := cli.Exchange()(context.Background(), &numbers.EnumAlias{N: &value})
		host.Close()
		if n == 2 {
			if err != nil {
				t.Errorf("valid response rejected: %v", err)
			} else if result := raw.(*numbers.EnumAlias); result.N == nil || *result.N != 2 {
				t.Errorf("invalid decoded response: %#v", result)
			}
		} else if err == nil {
			t.Errorf("invalid response n=%d accepted: %#v", n, raw)
		}
	}
}
